name: Remove News / Weather / Widgets Pack
description: Removes the Windows News, Weather, and Widgets apps to reduce background activity and interface clutter. This is useful if you prefer a cleaner taskbar without these built-in panels.

description_i18n.en: Removes the Windows News, Weather, and Widgets apps to reduce background activity and interface clutter. This is useful if you prefer a cleaner taskbar without these built-in panels.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt die Apps für Nachrichten, Wetter und Widgets von Windows, um Hintergrundaktivität und UI-Clutter zu reduzieren. Dies ist nützlich, wenn du eine sauberere Taskleiste ohne diese integrierten Paneele bevorzugst.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les applications Actualités, Météo et Widgets de Windows pour réduire l'activité en arrière-plan et le désordre visuel. Utile si vous préférez une barre des tâches plus épurée sans ces panneaux intégrés.

warnings.title: App removal
warnings.message: This action removes installed apps. Windows or other applications may take a moment to rebuild local caches if they were using these components.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Removes installed and provisioned Bing News, Microsoft News, Bing Weather, and Client.WebExperience Appx packages for all users.
